title: 甘くて真っ赤な1ページ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower and I are headed home after some bonus training and lunch on a day off, when…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother! Look! They're holding an apple fair!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister! Look! They're holding an apple fair!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Apple jelly, apple tarts… Whoa! It all looks so good!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I love them. They bring back a precious memory…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You see, I got lost once at a festival once when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: My mom found me pretty quickly, but I couldn't stop crying…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So she bought me a candy apple. And when I took a bite…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It was so sweet that it made me feel happy and warm again… I stopped crying right away.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. So that's why I likes apples! I feel warm inside when I eat them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, they smell so nice. Thinking about that time again makes me want to eat one…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But… we probably shouldn't have any now. We did just eat lunch…
choice_data_list: We can come back when we're hungry.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, you're right. We did just eat…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I guess we could come back after training sometime…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I bet those apples will taste even better on an empty stomach…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We turn our backs to the pleasant smell wafting from the apple fair and leave.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Room for dessert? You mean I can have some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! Okay, I'll get a tart. And jelly. And juice. And…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Rice Shower eats pretty much everything at the apple fair.
